name: Camping 101: Alchemy

angles.text: A campsite needs a campfire, a practical skill taught by cooking trainers across the realms.
In Ironforge, alchemists can seek Vosur Brakthel's guidance on preparing restorative concoctions for their journeys.

faq.answer: Vosur Brakthel is an alchemy trainer in Ironforge. He teaches alchemists to use their craft to make a Mana Well for companions in the field.

aliases: what does a mana well do
faq.answer: A Mana Well is an alchemical fixture for a wilderness camp. It helps spellcasters and healers recover as they travel.
No. City folk frown on camps pitched in Ironforge's streets, so take your Mana Well beyond the city to the wilderness.
faq.q: Can you set up a camp inside Ironforge?

aliases: do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: A camp also needs a campfire. If you do not know how to make one, seek a cooking trainer before heading out.
faq.q: What else is needed to set up a camp?

aliases: when can i learn mana well
faq.answer: Vosur Brakthel teaches alchemists who have taken up the profession and shown some skill in it. With that experience, they can learn to make a Mana Well.
faq.q: When can an alchemist learn to make a Mana Well?

faq.answer: Spellcasters and healers benefit most from a Mana Well. It helps them replenish their mana while traveling far from town taverns and hearthstones.
faq.q: Who benefits most from a Mana Well at camp?

sections.body: Vosur Brakthel trains alchemists in Ironforge to carry their craft beyond the city. Brewing vials in a quiet laboratory is only part of the work. Out in Azeroth's wild places, alchemists can use what they know to make a Mana Well for a camp, helping companions endure the journey.
sections.title: Brewing for the Road

sections.body: A Mana Well can refresh healers and spellcasters, but it belongs at a wilderness camp, not on an Ironforge street. City folk frown on tents pitched within their walls. A proper camp also needs a fire, so seek a cooking trainer's guidance before heading into the wild.
sections.title: Wilderness Campsites

summary: In Ironforge, Vosur Brakthel shows alchemists how to prepare for the road. With a Mana Well, they can give spellcasters and healers a place to recover while traveling.
